resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code. Alternative DFT codes (e.g., ABINIT, GPAW) are acceptable if the same quantities can be obtained.

resources.notes: Used for geometry optimisation and elastic constant calculation via the strain–stress method.

resources.name: SSSP pseudopotential library

access.notes: Provides ultrasoft pseudopotentials for the GGA-PW91 exchange–correlation functional. The agent should select appropriate potentials for W, C, and N.

resources.notes: High-quality pseudopotentials are needed for reliable elastic constants. Other reputable pseudopotential libraries may be used as substitutes.
